notes.title: About save data
notes.content:
Currently, there is a bug that the save file cannot be read correctly. I'm sorry.
Sorry to trouble you, but the data can be returned in the following ways.

🔶How to restore data🔶
1. Open Explorer and open C:\Users\your username\AppData\Local
2. Open the file named "路地裏漂流記" or "bakearrey"
(If you started the game after July 29th, it's probably a "bakearrey" file)
3. Open the file called "Saved"
4. If there is a file called "SaveGames" in the files, go back to the previous item and copy the "Saved" file
5. Find and open the file "Backalley" and paste the copied "Saved" file (it's okay to replace the file)
Even if you open the game above, the part that was not recorded should return. Still can't! If you are interested, please contact discord. ↓
https://discord.com/invite/RTJmF7N4gx

I wish I could change the file name on my side, but I can't find a good way, so this is the response. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to everyone who has been playing the game.
